scope: Revalidate the current canonical assistant VM after the user reported that it was awake; preserve and record the observed screen-sleep recurrence and safe wake result.

vm.reference: Domain/OS SR10.4 + HP VUE 2.01; MAME 0.276 Apollo DN3500

observation.pre_wake_result: The guest framebuffer was black except for the persistent Apollo command legend, despite the user having reported the screen awake earlier. This is a new observation, not a correction to the user report.
observation.wake_method: One-frame Shift pulse through the already validated MAME Apollo keyboard4/Shift input; automatically cleared on frame 3. This is guest-injected MAME input, not described as physical host input.
observation.visible_result: VUE desktop, Terminal, File Manager and Trash Can are visible; horizontal and vertical scrollbars are visible.

limits: No mouse movement or scrollbar press was sent.
The snapshot contains no visible pointer over an arrow; historical held horizontal comparison remains gated by R275 pointer-visibility rule.
The user was right that the VM had previously been awake; this capture shows it had returned to screen sleep by this later check.
